state.paragraph: On August 29, 2013, members of Mac-Gray management, representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and representatives of Party C participated in an in-person session for Party C to conduct follow-up and confirmatory due diligence.

ledger_rows.Note: BofA letter instructed revised written proposals by 09/09/2013 to continue to in-depth evaluation; covered valuation, financing, approvals and diligence focus.
Round 2 due date reached; CSC/Pamplona and Party B submitted; Party A and Party C submitted late and were reviewed on 09/11/2013.
Pamplona committed to 100% of required capital; requested two-week exclusive negotiations; no financing contingency reported.
Equity from affiliated funds plus third-party debt; no firm financing commitment reported.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
